prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +1.6% after noise correction across 5 tests with 2 wins, though 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 3 tests with 1 win, though 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_screen; adoption, new_flow; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each, all showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.0% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.5% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.6% after noise correction, 5 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Pet Selector Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a full carousel layout featuring pet animation previews to help users select their favorite companion faster. (why: Adoption is the largest drop-off in the funnel (60.9% conversion), and visual carousel previews help users connect with pets quickly.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Screen Immediately After Pet Selection: Reorder the sign-in screen to occur right after picking a pet companion, securing the choice early before heavy processing steps. (why: Reordering sign-in has proven effective (+1.6% average lift), and securing pet choice early helps prevent support issues regarding missing/reset pets.)
2: [home, redesign] Stage Layout Pet Crafting Waiting Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout showcasing an animated pet crafting process. (why: The waiting step has high latency (mean 2336s). A visually rich stage layout reassures users that custom creation is actively taking place.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Clarification: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen letting returning users know that signing in will automatically restore their existing pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Generation Quality Sample Hint: Add a photo sample preview component and guidance hint on the photo upload screen demonstrating optimal lighting and angles. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or producing bad results, contributing to adoption step drop-off.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Clarity Headline: Update the choose_path screen headline and hint to clearly distinguish between picking a preset pet companion and creating a custom pet. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean drop-off time (514s), indicating hesitation and lack of clarity on path differences.)
6: [finish, copy] System Tray Pet Control Guide: Add detailed instructions to the home intro screen explaining how to summon, hide, or manage the pet using the desktop system tray icon. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Notification When Pet is Ready: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts during the waiting step so users feel comfortable minimizing the app. (why: The waiting step has a high mean time of 2336s. Allowing users to safely minimize the window prevents abandonment during pet processing.)
8: [choose_path, redesign] Split Story Desktop Mascot Intro Redesign: Redesign the onboarding story intro into a split screen layout featuring a mascot graphic showing the pet resting on a work desktop. (why: Improving the initial hook sets clear expectations for how desktop pets integrate with daily computer use.)
